comments.author: @FOOLMUSIC
comments.text:
MACHINE is an invitation to my new sound that developed at the start of 2020.
The concept behind this album is that the F.O.O.L character is hooked up to a machine which is making him evolve and become more powerful, symbolic of how I have evolved my sound.
For a little over a decade now, I have been creating and experimenting with all different kinds of genres across the world of electronic music.
It is not until now that it finally feels like I am creating the type of music that I always wanted to make.

Diversity has always been super important to me, and that is also something I wanted to express in MACHINE, while staying true to my distinct sound.
This album takes inspiration from my vision of the F.O.O.L character, along with my interest in dystopian and futuristic themes.
I love to create atmospheric and cinematic ambiances so each listener can imagine their own story through this musical journey.

Massive thanks to Extra Terra, THIRST, Hayve, Waveshaper, PYLOT, Jnathyn, A.L.I.S.O.N, INHUMAN & SKUM for being part of this.

Also massive thanks to Sybervision for the awesome Machine Art/Visualizer, Mike Yakovlev & Kadabura for their art contributions and last but definitely not least: Audrius (audr_im) for making a bunch of additional animations/art for the singles, album animations and just being such a huge support/help for anything art related.

Thanks to the whole team & community on Monstercat for believing in my music and truly making me feel at home on the label. It honestly feels surreal to finally release an album on Monstercat and I'm so excited to hear your thoughts on the album! 🔺 ❤
